text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A new year has arrived. With this being
Wonder
Acute's classic year, we've got
plenty more goals
to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to do even more to support
her, I muster
my determination and
prepare to focus on the
long year ahead.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there, Trainer.
Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I went ahead and got you a little
something.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here's some New Year's pocket money.
Buy
whateeever you'd like, but try not
to spend it all
in one place! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
choice_data_list: ごめん、さすがにもらえないよ……
choice_data_list_en: Sorry, I really can't accept this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to be someone she can rely on, so
the idea
of accepting money from her
puts me in an
awkward position.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that to her, and add that it
would be
against academy rules.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? And here I was just hoping to
put a
smile on your face...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I even picked out that beautiful paper
and folded
the origami envelope myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I accept her handmade envelope, and
everything
is settled.
choice_data_list: なら、その袋だけ欲しいな！
じゃあ、その袋だけちょうだい！
choice_data_list_en: Then, I just want that bag!
Then just give me that bag!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. I'm starting my...

whatchamacallit... classic year, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Everyone running turf races seems to be
doing
quite a bit of hustling. Do I need
to hustle too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like with Umamusume who run on
turf, the
classic year is a make-or-break
time for dirt
runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby in the summer is
an
especially important race that all dirt
runners
aspire to compete in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd like for us to make our way there and
do well.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then, I need to put my nose to the
grindstone
and work just as hard as
everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The question is, which grindstone?
What's the
best way I can use my time
during New Year's
break?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hm... What should I have her do? The
first thing
that comes to mind is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You think so? I wonder if I can even do
whatever
it is they're all up to.
choice_data_list: 多彩な駆け引きを学ぶ
choice_data_list_en: Work hard at not working hard

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, there's a rather
snazzy
girl in my year I might be able to
learn a thing or
two from.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"A rather snazzy girl." She must be
talking about...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sure, fam. How's about we give those
nails a
glow-up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Tosen Jordan, Tracen Academy's

quintessential "snazzy girl."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, lemme see those nails. We'll pick
a style
based on their shape.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My nails? Oh, this is a bit embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're so smol! OMG, Acute,
your nails
are legit adorbs!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But that also means painting them's
gonna be
mad hard. No biggie—just
gotta focus, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wanna try it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes. I'm actually pretty good at
delicate tasks
like sewing and beadwork.
Let's do it together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them spend a "low-key" New
Year's
patiently painting Wonder
Acute's small nails.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Work hard at not working? Sounds a
little zen for
my blood.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But sure, I'll give it a go.
Let's see. What
can I do to not work?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess cooking? There are some
low-effort dishes
I could make in bulk
that should last through the
break.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll make some for you as well.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here we go—some turnip cakes! ♪ And I
made a
variety of sauces using family
recipes passed
down for generations.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have everything from a tangy
Polynesian sauce
to a rich cream sauce. I
made some sweet red
bean paste too, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I say we munch on these and have a
nice, relaxing
New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to take it easy, and my taste
buds go
on a culinary journey through
Wonder Acute's
family recipes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A wide range of tactics, you say? So
things like...
hoodwinking and pulling
fast ones, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I believe there's
someone in
my year who's an expert of
sorts in that field.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Wanna challenge me to a game of
cards,
do ya?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Nakayama Festa. She's a racer
with a
reputation for always living on the
edge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Fine by me. What rules are we using?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Rules? To be honest, I only know how to
play Old
Maid.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Old Maid? ...Heh, that'll do. Mind games
are my
specialty.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Get in on this too, Trainer. We'll have a

free-for-all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! That's my last pair! Looks like I'm
the
winner.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What in the hell?! I could've sworn you
had the
Old Maid...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, I did, but I discarded it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm a bit of an old maid myself, so that
makes a
pair.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... You're pretty devious under that
naive
facade. I underestimated you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's unconventional wisdom
gets the
better of Nakayama Festa. We
continue playing,
learning more tricks
along the way.
